_note: Single-source (Roman). Per culture-catalog 5.3, a single-source culture may use real-world forms or a same-palette conlang; Agrippan leans Latinate, mixing genuine Latin-style and coined forms (no specific historical-figure names). Agrippan deity-names ARE the canonical pantheon keys.

phonology.palette: Latinate: a e i o u; p t c(=k) b d g f s v l r m n; endings -us/-a/-um/-ius/-or; penultimate stress.
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; vowel-final common; clusters st/tr/pr/cl/sp; geminates ll/ss/tt allowed.

morphology.patronymic_form: inherited gens (clan) name as middle element, e.g. Marcus VALERIUS.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word, eliding final vowel before a vowel (ater + silva -> Atrasilva); or feature + civic suffix (vada -> Atravada).

title_ladder._tiers_note: Seven ACKS domain tiers, ascending by size (barony, march, county, duchy, principality, kingdom, empire) per RAW; the march is a small frontier holding between barony and county. All pairs are Latinate and rhyme on a shared stem. The march (frontier) tier is Limitanus/Limitania (from Roman limes/limitanei), leaving Dux/Ducatus for its proper meaning, the duchy. Per-tier family/realm size thresholds come from the ACKS domain rules (acore_axioms_strongholds_and_domains.xml); not reproduced here for IP.
title_ladder._government_note: Only feudal and clanhold governments are mechanically modeled; Agrippa's imperial-Roman character is aesthetic flavor over a feudal realm.
title_ladder._tier_levels_note: tier->ruler-level mapping pending the ACKS domain-tier lookup.

people_name_convention.order: praenomen (personal) + nomen (gens/clan, inherited) + cognomen (earned agnomen, optional)
people_name_convention.dual_register: patricians use the full tripartite gens; commoners often praenomen + occupational/patronymic byname.
people_name_convention.theophoric: praenomina derived from the canonical Agrippan deities: Tulrian, Orlandus, Argentius, Realtus, Numenius, Delorius, Numian, Noctilus (m); Realta, Lietia, Numia, Noctila (f).

religion._note: Agrippan deity-names ARE the canonical pantheon keys; Agrippan is the reference culture other cultures rename FROM (gdd-religion-system 5.2).
religion.the_one: Aeternus (the One / True God; honored in liturgy, not petitioned)
religion.religious_orders_pattern: Collegium of [domain]: Collegium of the Dawn Throne (Tulrius), Order of the Iron Oath (Orlandus).
religion.saints_pattern: Divus/Diva [name] (deified founders and heroes), e.g. Divus Agrippus the Founder.

banks_patterns._note: Settlement/region names assemble from lexicon+morphology; other categories follow these patterns (full lists assembled by the build step).
banks_patterns.ships: virtue/eagle/dawn names: Victrix, Aquila, Dawn of Agrippa
banks_patterns.military_units: Legio [ordinal] [cognomen]: Legio Prima Ferrata (the Iron Legion)
banks_patterns.taverns: The [Adjective] [Noun]: The Gilded Amphora, The Iron Eagle
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: [Tomb/Vault/Catacomb] of [name]: the Catacombs of Divus Aurelius
